bibl.title: "The Curses Will Be Like Oil in Their Bones": Excommunication and Curses in Bishops' Letters Beyond Late Antiquity.
bibl.seg: 145.13 / 145.8 P. Reinhardt Kirchenbann-Urkunde P. Ryl. Copt. 267 S.B. Kopt. II, 938; IV, 1778
Eline Scheerlinck, "The Curses Will Be Like Oil in Their Bones": Excommunication and Curses in Bishops' Letters Beyond Late Antiquity.
Mattias Brand & Eline Scheerlinck (edd.), Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri: 3rd-12th Century Egypt (London - New York, 2023) pp. 213-231.
bibl.note: Examines four letters from tenth-century to twelfth-century Egypt [S.B. Kopt. II, 938, P. Ryl. Copt. 267, P. Reinhardt Kirchenbann-Urkunde, S.B. Kopt. IV, 1778]. - Introduction. - Christian religious authorities in a changing legal landscape. - The letters. - Scripture in documentary Coptic traditions. - Daniel vs. Abraham: comparison with seventh-century bishops. - Performative aspect of the letters. - Intended and unintended effects of the letters. - Conclusion.
